subject: mathematics
title: Shape Trail
objective: Recognize and describe points, lines, line segments, rays, and special line relationships.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ A point marks a location. A line segment has two endpoints. A ray has one endpoint and continues in one direction. Parallel lines do not meet; perpendicular lines meet to form a right angle. Ready to explore?
